text.en: Established in 1943, New China serves Chinese-Filipino dishes near Prieto and General Luna streets.
Its upstairs dining room hosted wedding receptions, birthdays and other family celebrations.
Coffee served with evaporated or condensed milk made it a gathering place for journalists, artists and writers.
A 2026 visit documents its pancit and signature siopao; the former Beehive Cake is no longer served.
